d: Almediqa is a leading organization in the Hospital & Health Care industry, dedicated to providing exceptional mental health services to our diverse patient community. We are currently seeking a compassionate and skilled Registered Nurse specializing in Mental Care to join our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to work in an innovative healthcare environment where patient-centered care and clinical excellence are top priorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in psychiatric nursing and a genuine passion for improving the mental well-being of patients. You will be responsible for delivering comprehensive nursing care to individuals experiencing a range of mental health conditions, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to develop and implement effective treatment plans. At almediqa, we value professionalism, empathy, and continuous learning, and we encourage our nurses to engage in ongoing education and professional development. Join us to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients while advancing your career in a supportive and rewarding setting. If you are dedicated to mental health nursing and ready to take on new challenges, we invite you to apply and become part of the almediqa family.
q: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license with specialization or experience in mental health nursing.
Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience working with mental health patients in a hospital or healthcare setting.
Strong understanding of psychiatric disorders, treatments, and nursing interventions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with patients, families, and healthcare teams.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while demonstrating empathy and professionalism.
Proficient in electronic medical records (EMR) and standard nursing documentation practices.
Up-to-date knowledge of healthcare laws, regulations, and best practices in mental health nursing.
Certification in Basic Life Support (BLS) and Mental Health First Aid is preferred.
Willingness to participate in ongoing professional development and training programs.
r: li
Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments and document patient histories accurately.

li

li
Monitor patients’ progress and response to treatments, adjusting care plans as necessary.
